question: Where can I find a nature reserve that lie within 160 kilometers toward the east side of ABQ BioPark (Botanic Garden), Albuquerque, NM?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%ABQ BioPark (Botanic Garden)%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 160000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%ABQ BioPark (Botanic Garden)%' LIMIT 1 )), ST_Centroid(geometry) )) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
